description: Removes a tag from a question bank, by tagName or tagId from riddle_tag_list - exactly one of the two. Never creates anything: a tag the bank does not carry is an error. A tag nothing uses any more is deleted from the project, where "nothing" includes Riddles: a tag a Riddle still uses survives its last bank. Deleting a tagged bank cleans up the same way. This only ever takes the tag off THIS bank; riddle_tag_delete removes the label from the project itself. Rejected for a public template id. Needs full access: riddle://reference/concepts/access.

questionBankId.description: The ID of the question bank to untag.

tagId.description: The ID of an existing tag, as returned by riddle_tag_list. Pass either this or tagName.

tagName.description: The name of the tag. Nothing is ever created; a name the bank does not carry is an error. Pass either this or tagId.

name: question_bank_tag_remove
